g.text: Search the Own Cell's 8 Neighbors First -- Widen Only If Needed
A point near a cell edge can be closer to a neighboring cell's contents than its own cell's center
ring 2 -- searched ONLY if the 9 cells above return fewer than `limit` candidates
The query point sits near its own cell's NE corner -- the closest real candidates may actually live in the 'n', 'ne', or 'e' neighbor cells, not 'own'.
Searching only the 'own' cell would silently miss them; the 8-neighbor search is a correctness fix, not just a completeness optimization.
